en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Numan, from Ismail Bin Jabir,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
The Book of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, therein is news of what was before you, and information of what is to be after you, and detail of what is between you, and we<sup>asws</sup> know it (all)’.
en.sarwar: 9. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Ali ibn Ni‘man from ’Isma‘il ibn Jabir from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following. “
In the book of Allah there is the news of things before you, the reports of the matters after you and the laws to settle your disputes and we know it all.”
